scripts.dev: npm run fetch:feature-images && hugo server --config hugo.toml,hugo.development.toml
scripts.build:hugo:development: npm run fetch:feature-images && hugo --config hugo.toml,hugo.development.toml --minify --panicOnWarning --cleanDestinationDir --destination public-development
scripts.build: npm run build:hugo && node scripts/lint-local-images.mjs && npm run build:search
scripts.build:development: npm run build:hugo:development && PUBLIC_DIRECTORY=public-development node scripts/lint-local-images.mjs && npm run build:search:development
